title: Finalize self-check records a closed-set fail reason class per failing condition
summary: Each failing Finalize condition records a reason class as optional sub_reasons on its gate-verdict row; existing callers unchanged.

title: Hand closures record agent_count null; retro averages known counts only
summary: Hand closures write agent_count null (key required); retro Avg agents per run skips nulls and shows n, n/a at 0.
